templates.title: Button counter
templates.description: A button that counts clicks with a few lines of JavaScript.
templates.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <style>
    body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 1rem; }
    button { font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button id="counter">Clicked 0 times</button>
  <script>
    let count = 0;
    const button = document.getElementById('counter');
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      count++;
      button.textContent = `Clicked ${count} times`;
      console.log('count is now', count);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

templates.title: Contact form
templates.description: Labelled fields, a select, a textarea and browser validation.
templates.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <style>
    body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 1rem; max-width: 28rem; }
    label { display: block; margin-top: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; }
    input, select, textarea { width: 100%; padding: 0.4rem; margin-top: 0.25rem; }
    button { margin-top: 1rem; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form onsubmit="event.preventDefault(); console.log('Submitted', Object.fromEntries(new FormData(this)));">
    <label for="name">Name</label>
    <input id="name" name="name" required>
    <label for="topic">Topic</label>
    <select id="topic" name="topic">
      <option value="question">Question</option>
      <option value="feedback">Feedback</option>
    </select>
    <label for="message">Message</label>
    <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="3" required></textarea>
    <button type="submit">Send</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>

templates.title: JOIN and GROUP BY
templates.description: Total spent per customer across their orders.
templates.code:
SELECT c.name, c.country, ROUND(SUM(p.price * o.quantity), 2) AS total_spent
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

CREATE TABLE customers (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  country TEXT NOT NULL,
  joined TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE products (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  category TEXT NOT NULL,
  price REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ordered_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
